vectors.description: One zone is stored. ZONE_BEGIN from DISARMED (homed) enters ZONE_SETUP; a fire request is now denied ZONE_SETUP; the stored zones are unchanged.
BEGIN, all points and a correct CRC-32: the zone is listed with its CRC, the state is DISARMED and the upload is gone.
A wrong CRC-32 is rejected ZONE_BAD_CHECKSUM: the store is unchanged, the state is DISARMED and the upload is gone.
A polygon whose edges cross (and whose area is not zero) is rejected ZONE_SELF_CROSSING: the store is unchanged and the state is DISARMED.
A commit with one declared point missing is rejected ZONE_INCOMPLETE: the store is unchanged and the state is DISARMED.
Storage is full: the commit is rejected ZONE_STORAGE_ERROR, nothing is stored (not even half a zone) and the state is DISARMED. After storage recovers the same upload succeeds.
Storage is locked: the commit is rejected ZONE_STORAGE_ERROR and the store is unchanged.

Two points, then silence past zone_upload_timeout_ms (1000, shortened): still ZONE_SETUP just before the timeout; later DISARMED with the store unchanged; the next ZONE_POINT is rejected ZONE_NO_UPLOAD.
Two points, then DISARM: reply OK, state DISARMED, store unchanged, the upload is gone (the next point and commit are rejected ZONE_NO_UPLOAD).
Two points, then the key is turned off: SAFE_ERROR with fault KEY_OFF, armed false, the upload is gone and the store is unchanged.
Two points, then no heartbeat past watchdog_ms: SAFE_ERROR with fault HEARTBEAT_LOST, the upload is gone and the store is unchanged.
BEGIN id 5 with two points, then BEGIN id 6: the state stays ZONE_SETUP and a commit for id 6 succeeds. The points of id 5 never appear and no mixed zone is stored.
ZONE_BEGIN with 2 points from DISARMED is rejected ZONE_TOO_FEW_POINTS and the state stays DISARMED (ZONE_SETUP is not entered).
An upload is in progress; a BEGIN with 2 points is rejected ZONE_TOO_FEW_POINTS. The state stays ZONE_SETUP and the earlier upload continues and its commit succeeds.
An upload is in progress and the store fills up (max_zones 2): a BEGIN is rejected ZONE_STORE_FULL and the state stays ZONE_SETUP. When room is made again the earlier upload's commit succeeds.

In ZONE_SETUP: ARM and HOME are rejected WRONG_STATE, a fire request is denied ZONE_SETUP, ZONE_LIST and MOVE work, and a point with a bad index is rejected ZONE_BAD_INDEX. The state and the upload are unchanged: the upload still commits.
In ZONE_SETUP, ZONE_DELETE (known id, then unknown id) and ZONE_CLEAR work on the stored zones and change neither the state nor the upload, which still commits.
ZONE_BEGIN while armed (SCANNING) is rejected WRONG_STATE and the state is unchanged.

zone_upload_timeout_ms 5000, heartbeats every 200 ms. BEGIN at 0, a point at 3000, then STATUS_REQUEST, ZONE_LIST, MOVE and a stale-sequence message every 1000 ms from 4000 to 7000: none of them resets the idle timer, so the state is still ZONE_SETUP at 7900 (the point at 3000 reset it) and DISARMED at 8100.
A ZONE_POINT or ZONE_COMMIT with no upload in progress is rejected ZONE_NO_UPLOAD.
A point that is not the next expected index (skipping ahead, or repeating one) is rejected ZONE_BAD_INDEX and the upload is kept: the right points can still follow and the commit succeeds.
ZONE_BEGIN with 17 points (the limit is 16) is rejected ZONE_TOO_MANY_POINTS and the state stays DISARMED.
A zone with exactly 16 points (max_points_per_zone) is accepted and stored.
Eight zones are stored (max_zones 8): ZONE_BEGIN is rejected ZONE_STORE_FULL, the state stays DISARMED, and ZONE_LIST still reports all eight.
Committing an id that is already stored is rejected ZONE_DUPLICATE_ID; the stored zone keeps its original points.
Rejected ZONE_DEGENERATE: two consecutive points are the same. Nothing is stored.
Rejected ZONE_DEGENERATE: the three points lie on one line (zero area). Nothing is stored.
Rejected ZONE_DEGENERATE: a symmetric bow-tie has zero signed area, so the degenerate check, which comes first, reports it, not the crossing. Nothing is stored.
A commit that is both incomplete and has a wrong CRC-32 is reported ZONE_INCOMPLETE (check 2 before check 3).
A self-crossing polygon with a wrong CRC-32 is reported ZONE_BAD_CHECKSUM (check 3 before checks 5 and 6).
A zero-area polygon with an id that is already stored is reported ZONE_DEGENERATE (check 5 before check 7).
A self-crossing polygon with an id that is already stored is reported ZONE_SELF_CROSSING (check 6 before check 7).
Deleting a stored id removes only that zone; deleting an id that is not stored is rejected ZONE_UNKNOWN_ID and changes nothing.
ZONE_LIST reports no zones, then (after two uploads) both zones with their point counts and CRC-32 values.
ZONE_CLEAR removes every stored zone; the list is then empty and the store is valid.
A partial upload covering the direction the head points in is never used to decide a shot: after DISARM discards it and the device is armed again, a request is granted.
A second BEGIN with the same id and a different point count throws the first upload's points away: the stored zone has only the new points (3, not 4).
A stored zone whose bytes fail their checksum is still listed, and the store is reported invalid; this is not a fault.
